common.fixFields: Some fields are invalid — fix the marked fields.

common.unavailable: Discord or the database is currently unavailable. Try again in a minute.

settings.protected: Only the server owner or a Discord administrator can change this (it’s part of the permission system).
settings.channelList: The list contains a channel that isn’t on the server.
settings.roleMissing: This role doesn’t exist on the server.
settings.roleDangerous: This role grants moderation / administration permissions — only the owner or a Discord administrator can assign it.
settings.aiNotAllowed: Only the OrangenBot operator can allow this on this server.
settings.ladderInvalid: Invalid warning ladder (1–10 levels with a known action).
settings.ladderTimeout: A timeout must be between 1 and {max} minutes.

settings.quotasInvalid: Invalid quota line: “{line}” (format: role ID = minutes [= type]).

perms.adminOnly: Roles and permissions can only be changed by the server owner or a Discord administrator (just like in the bot).
perms.managedRole: @{role} is an integration (bot) role — it can’t be assigned to a level.
perms.duplicateRole: @{role} is on two levels at once — a role can only belong to one level.
perms.levelNotAllowed: “{capability}”: this level can’t be chosen here.
perms.noExtraRoles: “{capability}”: extra roles can’t be added to this permission.

shop.builtin: “{key}” is the ID of a built-in item — choose another one.
shop.roleDangerous: This role grants moderation / admin permissions — only the owner or a Discord admin can put it in the shop.
shop.exists: There’s already a product with the ID “{key}”.
shop.limit: A server can have at most {max} custom products.

filters.failed: That didn’t work — please try again.
filters.maxBlocked: There can be at most {max} blocked terms.
filters.notListed: It’s no longer on the list.
filters.maxAllowed: There can be at most {max} allowed terms.
filters.reviewed: This case has already been reviewed.

levelActions.roleMissing: This role doesn’t exist on the server.
levelActions.notAssignable: The bot can’t assign this role — the bot’s role must be above it (and it mustn’t be an integration role).
levelActions.dangerous: This role grants moderation / administration permissions — only the owner or a Discord administrator can give it as a reward.
levelActions.maxRewards: There can be at most {max} rewards.
levelActions.none: There’s no reward for this level.

branding.tooBig: The image can be at most 4 MB.
branding.format: Only PNG, JPG, GIF or WebP images can be uploaded.
branding.nickTooLong: The name can be at most {max} characters.
branding.bioTooLong: The bio can be at most {max} characters.

tickets.channelsUnavailable: The server’s channels are currently unavailable — please try again.
tickets.textChannelMissing: This text channel doesn’t exist on the server, or the bot can’t see it.
tickets.categoriesUnavailable: The server’s categories are currently unavailable — please try again.
tickets.categoryMissing: This Discord category doesn’t exist on the server.
tickets.rolesUnavailable: The server’s roles are currently unavailable — please try again.

tickets.categoryLimit: There can be at most {max} categories.

rolePanels.buttonsMax: A button panel can have at most {max} roles — keep it as a menu, or remove some roles.

rolePanels.image: The image link must start with https:// (no spaces).
rolePanels.thumbnail: The thumbnail must be an https:// link, “-” (none) or empty (the server icon).
rolePanels.duration: The duration must be like 30m, 2h, 1d, 1w (at most 30 days), or empty (permanent).
rolePanels.roleMissing: This role doesn’t exist on the server.
rolePanels.ownRole: A role on the panel itself can’t be a requirement or a restriction.
rolePanels.sameRules: The required role and the forbidden role can’t be the same — nobody could use the panel.
rolePanels.emojiUnreachable: The bot can’t access this custom emoji — choose one of the server’s own emojis.

rolePanels.ruleRole: This role is the panel’s required or forbidden role.
rolePanels.alreadyOn: This role is already on the panel.
rolePanels.full: The panel is full (at most {max} roles).

rolePanels.textChannel: Choose a text channel (the channel doesn’t exist or isn’t a text channel).
rolePanels.entryGone: This role is no longer on the panel — refresh the page.
rolePanels.entryGoneShort: This role is no longer on the panel.
rolePanels.panelLimit: There can be at most {max} role picker panels.

notifications.channelMissing: This channel doesn’t exist (or the bot can’t see it) — choose another one.

notifications.roleMissing: This role doesn’t exist — choose another one (or leave it empty).
notifications.roleManaged: This role can’t be pinged (it belongs to a bot / integration) — choose one of your own roles.
notifications.badStream: I can't read that as a {platform} channel — enter its name or link.
